correctness.rationale: The exact renewal age law is proved by generating functions. A differentiated coefficient-generating function yields the polynomial three-term recurrence. On the unit circle it becomes a tridiagonal symmetric real Jacobi matrix plus an imaginary scalar times a strictly positive diagonal, which cannot have a nullvector for nonzero asymmetry. Polynomial root continuity from z^t at gamma=0 and exact coefficient reciprocity prove the all-degree inside/outside dichotomy. At gamma=1/2 standard Legendre orthogonality gives the precise simple boundary roots. The independent finite checker passed 835 rational, determinant, root and Legendre assertions; finite checks supplement but do not substitute for proof.

value.rationale: Exact finite-time off-diagonal coherence cancellation for quantum inverse-age resetting is a natural control observable. The theorem identifies a sharp parameter boundary: at balance finitely many exact phase cancellations occur at each positive integer horizon; for any asymmetric reset strength no finite phase choice can cancel coherence, even though asymptotic decay occurs. The complete all-degree inside/outside spectral topology is a substantive, motivated extension of the already known balanced Legendre special case and not a routine parameter substitution.
